titles.romaji: Ginga Kikoutai Majestic Prince: Mirai e no Tsubasa
titles.english: Majestic Prince: Wings to the Future
titles.native: 銀河機攻隊 マジェスティックプリンス 未来への翼

description:
An all-new "episode 25" will be broadcast at the end of a rebroadcast of the original 2013 TV series, which will begin in July. The episode will connect the series to the new Majestic Prince film.

(Source: Anime News Network)
